hints: Reread the first point of the lesson: "XSS happens when untrusted input is rendered into a page without proper escaping, letting an attacker inject a script that runs in another user's browser session"

prompt: True or false: Stored XSS (malicious input saved and served to other users) is generally more dangerous than reflected XSS (requiring a crafted link to be clicked), since it affects any visitor without extra action
explanation: True — Stored XSS (malicious input saved and served to other users) is generally more dangerous than reflected XSS (requiring a crafted link to be clicked), since it affects any visitor without extra action
